question: In March 2022, 'Stree Manoraksha Project' was launched by _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Irani.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Women and Child Development Minister ****Smriti Irani** launched the Stree Manoraksha Project for capacity building of One Stop Centre, on** 2 March 2022.**
 
• This project has been designed to end the** cycle of violence against women.**
 
• **Smriti Zubin Irani** is an Indian politician and a former television actress and producer. 
 
• Irani was the **youngest minister in the ****2019 Council of Ministers**, when she was sworn in as a Cabinet Minister in** May 2019 at the age of 43.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d83b8016ceac0eb362412c09fcbf948c65ee766ff1286964db983a0001cab86b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uma Bharti** is an Indian politician and former **Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh.****​ **
 
• **Mamata Banerjee** is an Indian politician who is **serving as the eighth and current chief minister of the Indian state of West Bengal **since **20 May 2011**, the first woman to hold the office.
 
• **Vasundhara Raje Scindia** is an Indian politician, who has held two terms as the **chief minister of Rajasthan.**
